title: Sequencer.js solver lookup misses the solver names of older servers
summary: sequencer_solver_agent() matched Platesolver/Astrometry/ASTAP only, while the Imager Agent and the stated intent include the older-server INDIGO Solver Agent and Solver Agent names; such remote solvers fell back to a nonexistent Astrometry Agent @ host. Add the names.

resolution.evidence: Owner (Rumen G. Bogdanovski, 2026-11-02): the INDIGO Solver Agent and Solver Agent names were temporary and never released, so they are irrelevant for Sequencer.js; no change made. Recorded in quality-review.md.
